summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the Public Data Engine contract: it materializes Fase 1 library, source registry and quality inputs into FacilityPrior, ContextualBundle and Phase1Package outputs while preserving upstream references, provenance, lineage and deterministic identifiers. No material contract, boundary, metadata integrity or responsibility-separation violations were found.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Inline conformance smoke execution covered the documented happy path, deterministic repeat behavior under reordered input, malformed collection rejection, unresolved source reference rejection and forbidden inference-field rejection. The static test specification also covers sparse valid input, empty eligible input, extra registry entries, multiple quality records, pass criteria and fail criteria.
test_results.notes: Reviewed the contract, operational rules, technical schema, test specification, failure modes, implementation codebase and usage example. The engine validates structured upstream collections, preserves upstream library, source and quality identifiers, requires provenance and lineage metadata, emits PackagingRejection records for invalid candidates, withholds accepted packages when no eligible input remains and blocks inference, TAD, conclusion, recommendation, decision-grade and final-report fields.
